results.title: 2026 J/80 Worlds at CORK, Kingston Day 4
results.description: The J/80 World Championship will come down to one final day after another full schedule of racing Friday at Portsmouth Olympic Harbour. The 34-boat fleet completed four more races in a fading breeze, bringing the Championship to 10 races.
